events.text: Name first appeared as Sastamall in a letter from King Birger Magnusson.

evidence.quote: The name Sastamala first appeared in the form Sastamall in a letter from King Birger Magnusson from 1300 or 1303

events.label: founding
events.text: Municipality created by merging Vammala, Äetsä and Mouhijärvi into one town.

evidence.quote: Sastamala was created on January 1 , 2009 , when the municipalities of Vammala , Äetsä and Mouhijärvi were consolidated into a single town

events.label: merger
events.text: Kiikoinen joined Sastamala as an additional municipality.

evidence.quote: Later , Kiikoinen also joined Sastamala in 2013

events.label: honour
events.text: Declared the book capital of Finland.

evidence.quote: At the beginning of 2013 , the town of Sastamala was declared the book capital of Finland
